versions.content: Provide SA and TA to external service processors Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide source and target address to the external service processor, which is processing the UDS service request. Rationale: Sometimes the reaction of service processor implementations on a UDS request depend on the tester (SA) or on the target. AppliesTo: AP Dependencies: [RS_Diag_04169] Use Case: Flexibility for service processor implementations.
